reference_sql:
WITH spend AS (
  -- one row per channel and month with spend in 2024
  SELECT c.channel_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE)
)
SELECT b.channel_id, b.month, b.budget_eur, COALESCE(s.spend_eur, 0) AS spend_eur
FROM budget_monthly b
LEFT JOIN spend s ON s.channel_id = b.channel_id AND s.month = b.month
WHERE b.month BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-01'

   WHERE c.channel_id = b.channel_id AND CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE) = b.month) AS spend_eur
FROM budget_monthly b
WHERE b.month BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-01'

WITH spend AS (
  -- one row per channel and month with spend in 2024
  SELECT c.channel_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE)
)
SELECT b.channel_id, b.month, b.budget_eur, CASE WHEN s.spend_eur IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE s.spend_eur END AS spend_eur
FROM spend s
RIGHT JOIN budget_monthly b ON s.channel_id = b.channel_id AND s.month = b.month
WHERE b.month BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-01'

other_way.sql:
SELECT b.channel_id, b.month, b.budget_eur,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.spend), 0)
   FROM ad_spend_daily a
   JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
   WHERE c.channel_id = b.channel_id AND CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE) = b.month) AS spend_eur
FROM budget_monthly b
WHERE b.month BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-01'
other_way.tradeoff: A spend subquery for each budget row needs no outer join, but it sums the spend again for every channel and month.

solver.query:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT cp.channel_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns cp ON cp.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT b.channel_id, b.month, b.budget_eur, COALESCE(s.spend_eur, 0) AS spend_eur
FROM budget_monthly b
LEFT JOIN s ON s.channel_id = b.channel_id AND s.month = b.month
WHERE b.month BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
